## Summary
Brief description of the changes introduced in this pull request. Explain the problem solved or the feature implemented.

## Related Issue
Closes conecta-nexus/<repo-name>#<issue-number>

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user story implementation
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, tooling, or configuration
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates (README, OpenAPI/Swagger, docstrings)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior changes
- [ ] `test`: Unit or integration tests added/updated
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline or workflow changes

## Technical Checklist (Definition of Done)
- [ ] Code follows team naming standards and all commits/branches/PR titles are written in **English**.
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated with test coverage >= 80% (`pytest --cov` / `vitest`).
- [ ] All automated status checks passed in GitHub Actions (CI green).
- [ ] Local Podman/Docker containers build and run without errors.
- [ ] OpenAPI contracts and database migrations updated if endpoints or schemas changed.
- [ ] **STRICT NO SQUASH MERGE**: Merge method must be set to **"Create a merge commit"** (`--no-ff`).

## Reviewer Assignment (Code Owner)
- Assigned Code Owner: @<reviewer-username> (based on the team's Code Owners matrix)
